scripts.title: Auto Tiles | 4-Lane Auto-Tap & Hold Detection
scripts.features:
⚡ FEATURE OVERVIEW

🎮 Universal Play System

Multiple Input Modes: Choose whether the script uses simulated keyboard presses, mouse clicks, or both at the same time to ensure it works smoothly on any executor.

Human-Like Tapping: Adds tiny, randomized micro-delays to your taps so your gameplay looks like a real person, helping you avoid detection.

Anti-Stuck Protection: Automatically releases keys if a tile glitches or disappears, ensuring your keyboard never gets stuck holding a note.

🎯 Smart Detection & Timing

Instant Auto-Setup: Automatically finds the game board and the perfect hit-line the moment you open the game—no manual setup required.

Smart Tile Recognition: Instantly tells the difference between a quick tap and a long hold tile, no matter how fast the song gets.

Perfect Hold Releases: Tracks the exact end of long tiles and lets go at the perfect millisecond to maximize your score.

Lag-Free Performance: Clears out old tile data in the background instantly, keeping your game running smoothly with zero lag during extremely long songs.
